label: support
subject: Scanners
body: Every handheld scanner on the night shift just died. The crew cannot scan a single crate, and the truck leaves at 11. I need someone who can bring the scanners back before the dock closes.

label: support
subject: Clerk
body: Counsel has to file the exhibit list before the clerk's window shuts today. The generated index is blank. If it is not in the packet by 4, the hearing tomorrow starts without our documents.

label: support
subject: Payroll lock
body: An admin session we do not recognise is open on the payroll vault. Please lock it and force a sign-in reset before the 6pm pay run. Staff bank details are visible in that session.

label: support
subject: Lobby
body: The badge printer at reception is dead and a school group is standing in the lobby. Nobody can enter the labs until badges print. The first workshop starts in forty minutes.

label: lead
subject: Catalogue
body: The auction catalogue has to be on the public site before midnight or the house will pull tomorrow's lots. The upload job stops halfway. This is a same-day deadline with a real cancellation behind it.

label: support
subject: Morning sailing
body: The ticket desk cannot sell seats for the dawn ferry. The queue on the pier is already long and the sailing is in three hours. Passengers will miss the boat if sales stay closed.

label: support
subject: Regulator
body: The regulator asked for the access log before their office closes today. The export comes out empty. Without that file they open a formal inquiry tomorrow.

label: invoice
subject: Open bill
body: Invoice 7741 from the spring workshop is still open. The printer will not start the next run until it is settled. Amount due is GBP 640, and they need it today.

label: support
subject: Chart colour
body: No hurry on this. One chart on my own dashboard uses the old blue. Everyone else sees the new palette. Fix it whenever the queue is quiet.

label: support
subject: Font
body: How do I change the font on my own signature block? The rest of the team is fine. I just dislike the serif.

label: lead
subject: Archive
body: Could you estimate a quiet migration of our old archive into the new cabinet? Next quarter is fine. There is no launch date and nothing is broken. Budget is around EUR 7,000.

label: invoice
subject: Cycle
body: Invoice 220 is attached for the usual monthly hosting. Amount due USD 90. Pay it on the normal cycle. Nothing is blocked.

label: spam
subject: Field notes
body: Three notes from the glass studio this month. Unsubscribe if you would rather not get the monthly letter.

label: recruiter
subject: Role
body: I recruit for a records manager. The base salary is CAD 95,000. This is not a client project and there is no budget for a vendor.

label: spam
subject: Away
body: Automatic reply. I am out of the office until the 3rd and will read mail when I return.

label: personal
subject: Lunch
body: Want to grab lunch next Thursday near the station? No work talk. I found a place that does good lentils.

label: support
subject: My export
body: Whenever you have time. The export works for every colleague except me. My file comes out blank. It can wait until next week.

subject: Urdu note

subject: سؤال

label: lead
subject: 报价
body: 你好。我们想在下个季度把旧档案柜迁到新系统，想先要一个大致报价。没有上线日期，系统现在是好的。预算大约四万人民币。

label: invoice
subject: Rechnung
body: Guten Tag. Rechnung 88 für das übliche Hosting liegt bei. Offener Betrag 40 Euro. Bitte im normalen Lauf begleichen. Es ist nichts blockiert.

label: support
subject: Couleur
body: Pas pressé. Sur mon écran seulement, le bouton enregistrer est gris. Les autres postes vont bien. Regardez cela la semaine prochaine.

label: lead
subject: Orçamento
body: Olá. Queria um orçamento para arquivar os processos antigos no próximo semestre. Nada está parado. O valor que temos em mente é cerca de 3.000 euros.

subject: Hindi note

subject: نسخ

subject: 仓库
